name: What factors should I consider when choosing an ADU builder?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing an ADU builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an ADU builder, consider their experience with local regulations in areas like Sherman Oaks or Glendale, their portfolio of completed ADU projects, and their communication style. Look for a builder who provides transparent pricing, offers clear timelines, and has positive client references. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they are reputable and comply with industry standards. A good builder will guide you through the entire process effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an ADU builder based on their experience with local regulations, portfolio, transparent pricing, communication, licensing, and client references.
